# Downstream pruning results

Each table is one model. The first data row is the unpruned Dense baseline. A full-width row marks each sparsity. Each method then occupies two rows: raw accuracy, then the fraction of Dense kept on that dataset. The rightmost column averages those per-dataset retained percentages into an overall retention rate.

MixPlus always keeps a Mix core and (unless noted) rescues the remaining budget with weighted pseudo-rankings. Sources: **PP** = current-layer router-row probes; **PRP** = previous-layer `down_proj` writes (native Top-K filtered); **LayerProp / LP** = data-free decoder hidden-state rankings. Gemma4 LP variants turn PP off (router RMS is a poor proxy of expert FFN input).

| Table label | Old token | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MixPlus PP+PRP v1 | AIMERMixPlus | Mix + PP + PRP, first fusion |
| MixPlus PP+PRP v2 | AIMERMixPlusV2 | Mix + PP + PRP, retuned fusion |
| MixPlus PP only | AIMERMixPlusPP | Mix + PP ablation |
| MixPlus PRP only | AIMERMixPlusPRP | Mix + PRP ablation |
| MixPlus LayerProp only | AIMERMixPlusLPOnly | Mix + LayerProp ablation |
| MixPlus LP+PRP | AIMERMixPlusLP | Gemma4: Mix + LayerProp + PRP (default fusion) |
| MixPlus LP+PRP aggressive | AIMERMixPlusLPa | same sources; stronger LayerProp, more Mix replace |
| MixPlus LP+PRP mild Mix | AIMERMixPlusLPb | same sources; milder Mix rescue |
| LayerProp + PRP | AIMERMixPlusLPx | no Mix core; LayerProp + PRP only (`ignore_base`) |
| LayerProp + PRP adaptive | AIMERMixPlusLPxa | no Mix; per-expert λ S_LP + (1-λ) S_PRP, λ = N/(N+τ) |
| MixPlus LP+PRP hard Mix replace | AIMERMixPlusLPh | same sources; even smaller Mix core |
| LayerProp only | AIMERMixPlusLPnb | no Mix core; LayerProp rankings only |
| PRP only | AIMERMixPlusPRPnb | no Mix core; PRP rankings only |

Regenerate:

```bash
python scripts/compile_results_md.py
```
